_note: Static wiki reference data for livestock, to enrich the memory-derived Animal Viewer records (see data/pointer_map.md's 'Animal (Coop/Barn) struct' section). Not memory-derived except 'id'. 'id' will link a game memory value to the animal's species/type -- this is NOT wiki-derivable (the Animal record's own struct layout has no confirmed species-identifying field yet, only Name/Affection/Fed-day fields through +0x19D), so every 'id' here is null pending live investigation, the same kind of open item as crops.json's crop-type index. Maturity is split into two separate paths, since a purchased animal and a Breeding-Kit-produced baby start from different life stages: 'days_to_mature_purchased' is how long a just-bought animal takes to reach full Adult (0 = arrives already mature -- true for every animal here except Cow/Coffee Cow/Fruit Cow/Strawberry Cow, which arrive as a Calf and still need time to grow); 'days_to_mature_bred' is how long a Breeding-Kit-produced baby (born on the farm) takes to reach full Adult from Day 0. Both use the LOWER number of each wiki range (the fastest case, i.e. fed every day) -- a missed feeding delays either path by a day, up to a wiki-listed cap. Cows/Coffee Cows/Fruit Cows/Strawberry Cows list bred maturity as two stages (Baby->Calf 14, then Calf->Adult 9); 'days_to_mature_bred' for those four is the sum of both (23), since 'days_to_mature_purchased' (9) already covers the Calf->Adult leg alone. 'pregnancy' is the Breeding Kit's gestation period (days from breeding to birth) and is separate from either maturity path. Chickens don't get pregnant, so their 'pregnancy' field instead holds the Egg Incubation period, and their 'days_to_mature_bred' (7) is chick-to-adult only, after that incubation. The Horse can't be purchased or bred (a one-time free gift from Mugi, Spring 4th Year 1 -- no purchase_at, no breeding kit) so both maturity fields are null; its 90-day pony-to-adult growth lives in 'days_to_mature_gifted' instead. 'url' is each animal's own stratswiki page, from the animals listing page's own links -- for the Reminders window's Animals section 'Animal' column hyperlink (app/windows/reminders.py).

ANIMALS.name: Chicken
ANIMALS.notes: 'pregnancy' holds Egg Incubation days (3), not a pregnancy period -- chickens don't get pregnant. 'days_to_mature_bred' (7) is chick-to-adult only, starting after that incubation.

ANIMALS.name: Cow
ANIMALS.notes: Arrives as a Calf when purchased (9 days to Adult), not fully mature like other livestock. days_to_mature_bred = 14 (Baby->Calf, lower bound) + 9 (Calf->Adult, lower bound) = 23
